ios.desc:
Simple camera app to take pictures and video. No filters, stickers or buttons. Just the way the world was meant to be seen!

* Tap anywhere on the screen to take a photo!

* Hold screen to take video. Release to stop video.
* Double tap screen to change camera (front / back).
* Hold and swipe/drag finger forward to zoom in or backwards to zoom out. 
* Pinch anywhere to zoom

Saves to your camera roll.
Works in portrait and landscape mode!

Used by many for OBS live streaming to stream from multiple camera sources in HD.

The maddening/frustrating part is that Apple ACTUALLY APPROVED almost exactly the same thing, and ironically, by another commenter elsewhere in this thread:

https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=32526387

The app is by the same developer, and is findable at https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zero-ui-gesture-only-camera/id960929710

So clearly, the App Review process is not deterministic, and highly dependent on which reviewer you get or something similar.
quotes.story_title: App Store doesn't accept “too simple” apps
